title: Settlement Infrastructure, Inside Money Elasticity, and the Network Economics of Distributed Ledger Technology
abstract: arXiv:2607.22459v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We construct the Settlement Modernisation Index, a panel dataset of 809 reform events across 24 advanced economies between 1993 and 2024, decomposed into three economic channels and three adoption phases. We document an S-curve in inside money elasticity with two interior turning points at SMI = 0.27 and 0.93, separating a liberation phase, a post-global-financial-crisis compliance valley, and a mature-infrastructure recovery phase. We show that settlement modernisation generates network-conditional balance sheet efficiencies through a T2S event-study with year-by-year EMIR decomposition (saturation beta = +0.557, p < 0.01) and an out-of-sample synthetic control null on Switzerland's post-2021 SDX deployment. Applied along the BIS three-layer connectivity taxonomy, the framework forecasts +13.4 percent efficiency recovery from the ECB's Pontes initiative over 2027-2032. Conditional UK and US accession to the Appia composability layer

translated_title: 结算基础设施、内部货币弹性与分布式账本技术的网络经济学
translated_abstract: 我们构建了结算现代化指数，这是一个涵盖1993年至2024年间24个发达经济体共809项改革事件的面板数据集，并将其分解为三个经济渠道和三个采用阶段。我们记录了内部货币弹性呈S形曲线演化的规律，其在SMI = 0.27和0.93处存在两个内部拐点，将发展历程划分为解放阶段、全球金融危机后的合规低谷以及成熟基础设施的复苏阶段。我们通过T2S事件研究并结合EMIR法规的逐年分解（饱和系数β = +0.557，p < 0.01），以及对瑞士2021年后SDX部署的样本外合成控制零结果，证明结算现代化会产生以网络为条件的资产负债表效率。应用国际清算银行三层连接分类法，该框架预测欧洲央行Pontes计划在2027至2032年间将带来13.4%的效率恢复。关于英国和美国有条件加入Appia可组合层的内容（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文构建了覆盖24个发达经济体809项改革事件的结算现代化指数（SMI），首次揭示内部货币弹性随结算基础设施现代化呈S形曲线演化的规律，并通过事件研究与合成控制方法证明结算现代化能够产生网络条件下的资产负债表效率提升，预测欧洲央行Pontes计划将带来13.4%的效率恢复。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs a Settlement Modernisation Index from 809 reform events across 24 advanced economies, documents an S-curve in inside money elasticity with two turning points, and demonstrates that settlement modernisation generates network-conditional balance sheet efficiencies, forecasting a 13.4% efficiency recovery from the ECB's Pontes initiative.
